premise: Badger fetches fresh grass for his burrow bed, and by the time it is soft, Hedgehog has curled up in it first.
inspiration: Goldilocks (folk), turned: the one who finds the bed taken makes room, and the guest is welcome.
lesson: Sharing what you made makes it better.
learning: Badgers carry fresh grass into their burrows for a soft bed

en-US.title: Badger Makes a Bed
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 45s} Every evening, {badger:enter} Badger {badger:pulse} tidies his burrow. {badger:face sad} Tonight, his bed felt scratchy. Hmm, said Badger. {badger:face happy} Time for fresh grass! He gathered a big bundle of soft, dry grass, and shuffled backwards into his burrow, {sfx:rustle} rustle, rustle, holding it tight under his chin. {mouse:enter} Mouse {mouse:hop} helped carry the little bits. Back and forth, back and forth, until the bed was deep and soft and smelled of sunshine. {badger:sparkle} [sighs] Perfect, said Badger. {badger:face surprised} But who was that, right in the middle? {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:live} Hedgehog! He yawned, curled up into a ball, peeked out… and uncurled. [curious] Is this bed for anyone? he asked. Badger {badger:wobble} scratched his head. {badger:face happy} Then he smiled. [softly] There's room for three, he said. And Badger, Mouse and Hedgehog {badger:hearts} {mouse:hearts} {badger:face sleeping} {mouse:face sleeping} {hedgehog:face sleeping} slept in the softest bed in the forest.

es-ES.title: Tejón hace la cama
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 45s} Todas las tardes, {badger:enter} Tejón {badger:pulse} ordena su madriguera. {badger:face sad} Esta noche, su cama picaba. Mmm, dijo Tejón. {badger:face happy} ¡Hace falta hierba fresca! Juntó un gran montón de hierba suave y seca, y entró de espaldas en su madriguera, {sfx:rustle} fru, fru, sujetándola bien con la barbilla. {mouse:enter} Ratón {mouse:hop} le ayudó con los trocitos pequeños. De aquí para allá, de allá para aquí, hasta que la cama quedó honda y blandita, y olía a sol. {badger:sparkle} [sighs] Perfecta, dijo Tejón. {badger:face surprised} Pero ¿quién estaba ahí, justo en medio? {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:live} ¡Erizo! Bostezó, se hizo una bola, asomó la nariz… y se desenrolló. [curious] ¿Esta cama es para alguien?, preguntó. Tejón {badger:wobble} se rascó la cabeza. {badger:face happy} Luego sonrió. [softly] Aquí cabemos tres, dijo. Y Tejón, Ratón y Erizo {badger:hearts} {mouse:hearts} {badger:face sleeping} {mouse:face sleeping} {hedgehog:face sleeping} durmieron en la cama más blandita del bosque.
